summary_1line: After Rama departs for exile, the palace, city, and even nature fall into grief, lamenting the loss of the virtuous prince.

image_candidates.scene_text: The women of the palace weep together in the inner chambers, crying out for Rama like cows bereft of their calves.
King Dasaratha stands trembling and drenched in sweat, staring helplessly at Rama’s chariot disappearing into the distance.
In ominous skies, dark planets crowd around the moon while the stars dim, reflecting the sorrow of the world after Rama’s exile.
